description: Main source file for Bluetooth broadcast audio assistant, handling scanning, connection, and broadcast source/sink management in Zephyr RTOS.

methods.name: device_found
methods.description: Parses advertising data to identify broadcast source or sink, extracting names, IDs, and capabilities.

methods.name: is_substring
methods.description: Checks if a substring exists within a string, case-insensitive.

methods.name: scan_recv_cb
methods.description: Callback for processing received scan data, handling source and sink discovery.

methods.name: scan_for_broadcast_source
methods.description: Starts passive scanning for broadcast sources.

methods.name: scan_for_broadcast_sink
methods.description: Starts passive scanning for broadcast sinks.

methods.name: security_changed_cb
methods.description: Handles security level changes on Bluetooth connections.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal state and semaphores for a new scan cycle.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing Bluetooth and managing broadcast source/sink lifecycle.
